content.text: Out[1]= <|"assumptions" -> "Element[t | h1 | h2 | r | s | lam, Reals] && r != 0", "scope" -> "Exact parametric 2x2 checks, not a general proof", "checks" -> <|"metric_compatibility" -> True, "norm_generator_identity" -> True, "Pi_idempotence" -> True, "Pi_metric_self_adjoint" -> True, "Q_Hermitian" -> True, "Q_metric_idempotence" -> True, "Qdot_product_inverse_formula" -> True, "W_Hermitian" -> True, "A_similarity" -> True, "Pi_similarity" -> True, "Q_congruence" -> True, "W_congruence" -> True, "generalized_characteristic_polynomial" -> True, "Q_not_ordinary_idempotent_example" -> True|>, "all_passed" -> True, "selected_gram" -> {{2 + t*(2 + t)}}, "Pi" -> {{(1 + t)/(2 + t*(2 + t)), (1 + t + t^2)/(2 + t*(2 + t))}, {(1 + t)/(2 + t*(2 + t)), (1 + t + t^2)/(2 + t*(2 + t))}}, "Q" -> {{1 - (2 + t*(2 + t))^(-1), t + (2 + t*(2 + t))^(-1)}, {t + (2 + t*(2 + t))^(-1), 1 + t^2 - (2 + t*(2 + t))^(-1)}}, "Qdot" -> {{(2*(1 + t))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2, 1 - (2*(1 + t))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2}, {1 - (2*(1 + t))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2, 2*(t + (1 + t)/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2)}}, "W" -> {{(2*(1 + t))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2, (t^2 + I*h1*(1 + t)*(2 + t*(2 + t)) - I*h2*(1 + t)*(2 + t*(2 + t)))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2}, {(t^2 - I*h1*(1 + t)*(2 + t*(2 + t)) + I*h2*(1 + t)*(2 + t*(2 + t)))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2, (-2*(1 + t + t^2))/(2 + t*(2 + t))^2}}|>
